# ESAIA Enterprise QR & Smart Link Platform

> Production-grade multi-tenant SaaS platform for dynamic QR codes, landing page builders, digital business cards, smart links, and scan analytics.

## Overview
ESAIA provides enterprise-grade infrastructure for generating, designing, managing, and tracking dynamic QR codes, mobile-first micro-pages, and digital vCards.

## Core Capabilities
- Dynamic QR Generation with Vector Rendering (SVG, ultra-high-resolution PNG, and print-ready JPEG 300 DPI)
- Visual Landing Page Builder with drag-and-drop sections
- Digital Business Cards (vCard 3.0 / 4.0) with contact saving
- Real-time Edge Redirection & Scan Telemetry
- Multi-Tenant Workspace & Client Fleet Management
